ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey to black) with localized high-intensity (white/grey) pixels; estimated macro-level white-to-black ratio of 1:12.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white clusters located at the distal tips of both lobes; scattered light-grey linear streaks and mottling concentrated in the central-lower region; overall surface is >90% dark pigmentation.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped indentation; interior pixel angle approximately 42 degrees with a clear focal point at the peduncle junction.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile; peak-to-valley amplitude ranges from 5 to 15 pixels; edge profile shows significant jaggedness particularly on the outer third of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature on the outer lateral margins, transitioning to a linear-to-concave sweep as the edge approaches the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of circular white pixel clusters (3-10 pixel diameter) on the right distal tip; smaller isolated white circular markers visible along the trailing edge of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, dark linear disruptions (rake marks) observed; notable vertical scratching on the left lobe and diagonal scratching in the mid-lower section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across both lobes; irregular chipping and potential tissue loss along the serrated trailing edge; focal white scarring at the lobe extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetric serration density, with the right lobe displaying more pronounced terminal jaggedness compared to the left.
